scope: Artifact-backed manifest for CAS-vs-baseline claims already visible in local docs/UI.
manifest_known_bound: This file records public-facing claims visible in the local UI/docs only. It does not add unpublished claims, infer missing evidence packet IDs, or invent missing hashes.

claims.headline: Internal state readout beats text baseline on visible Pythia readout claims
claims.model_stage: Pythia-160M Foundation probe Stage 7; Pythia-160M 40-element readout Stage 9; UI Stage 26 summary also displays OLMo-1B and Qwen2.5-1.5B readouts.
claims.cas_result: Pythia-160M Foundation probe 78.6%; Pythia-160M 40-element probe 89.8%; OLMo-1B 90.6%; Qwen2.5-1.5B 82.0%.
claims.baseline_control_result: Text baseline was lower by +28.9 percentage points on Foundation and +39.7 points on the 40-element readout.
claims.p_value: Pythia-160M Foundation p ~= 1e-95 vs text baseline; Pythia-160M 40-element McNemar p = 0 at machine precision. No local p-value found for the visible OLMo/Qwen readout summary.
claims.known_bound: Readout-level claim only. The UI-visible OLMo/Qwen readout values are present in local source, but no local evidence packet trace ID or p-value was found for those rows.

claims.headline: CAS subspace ablation collapses Foundation readout to chance
claims.model_stage: Pythia-160M Foundation subspace validation; Stage 7.1 in the CAS Harness spec sheet.
claims.cas_result: Foundation readout dropped from 78.6% to 3.57% after CAS subspace ablation.
claims.baseline_control_result: 3.57% is exact 1-in-28 chance. Random same-rank ablations had mean disruption 0.000 and max 0.000.
claims.n_sample_size: 28 Foundation classes; per-claim row count not stated in the visible UI/spec summary.
claims.known_bound: Causal readout-ablation claim only. It does not assert free-form generation control, complete circuit discovery, or raw CAS-symbol understanding.

claims.headline: CAS-conditioned choices move likelihood in the predicted direction
claims.model_stage: Pythia-160M Stage 7.CPL2; Pythia-1B Stage 8; UI-visible OLMo-1B/Qwen2.5-1.5B likelihood summary.
claims.cas_result: Likelihood shifts: Pythia-160M +0.283, Pythia-1B +0.554, OLMo-1B +0.604, Qwen2.5-1.5B +0.796.
claims.baseline_control_result: Raw-CAS-symbol control on Qwen was near null at -0.0002; the Pythia spec also states raw CAS symbol prefixes had no effect.
claims.n_sample_size: Pythia likelihood table reports 112 paired cases for Pythia-160M and Pythia-1B; no local n found for the visible OLMo/Qwen likelihood summary.
claims.p_value: Pythia-160M p < 0.0001; Pythia-1B p = 2.58e-14. No local p-value found for the visible OLMo/Qwen likelihood summary.
claims.known_bound: Likelihood-tier claim only. The local spec explicitly bounds visible-text steering at small-model scale as not closed.

claims.headline: Accepted OLMo/Qwen rows are high-accuracy with coverage reported separately
claims.model_stage: Stage 22.4 OLMo/Qwen diagnostic rows; Verification Stack UI summary.
claims.cas_result: OLMo accepted accuracy 98.16% at 71.73% coverage; Qwen accepted accuracy 99.49% at 74.57% coverage.
claims.baseline_control_result: Accepting everything would hide risk; CAS reports accepted-row accuracy and coverage separately so suppressed or triaged rows remain visible.
claims.n_sample_size: Stage 22.4 UI method summary says full diagnostic rows were emitted for all 4,704 OLMo/Qwen rows; accepted-row denominators by model are not stated locally.
claims.known_bound: Verifier/product behavior claim only. It does not claim every row is accepted or that suppressed/triaged rows are correct.

claims.headline: Inversion scanner produced numeric proxy rows for every OLMo/Qwen diagnostic row
claims.model_stage: Stage 22.6/22.7 inversion proxy attribution over OLMo/Qwen diagnostic rows.
claims.cas_result: Stage 22.6/22.7 measured 4,704 of 4,704 rows: numeric proxy rate 1.000.
claims.baseline_control_result: Stage 22.5 had 0 numeric inversion rows; inversion fields were reserved but not measured.
claims.known_bound: Numeric proxy coverage only. The UI source explicitly bounds this as not a full semantic inversion theorem.
